measures.title: City of Eureka Charter Amendment (Mayor and Council salaries)
measures.summary: Amends the Eureka City Charter, which has fixed the Mayor's salary at $625 a month and each Councilmember's at $500 a month since 1988. Per the City Attorney's impartial analysis, the City Council could then raise the salaries by ordinance to as much as $1,250 a month for the Mayor and $1,000 a month for Councilmembers, possibly starting January 2027, and adjust them yearly after review by the Finance Advisory Committee.
measures.yesMeans: The Council may raise Mayor and Council salaries by ordinance and adjust them yearly.
measures.noMeans: The current Charter salary limits stay in place.

measures.title: City of Eureka Tax Measure (transient occupancy tax)
measures.summary: Raises Eureka's transient occupancy (hotel) tax, paid by guests staying 30 days or less in hotels, motels, campgrounds and short-term rentals, from 10% to 12% starting January 1, 2027, until changed by voters. Per the City Attorney's impartial analysis, it is a general tax estimated at about $700,000 a year that goes into the city's general fund.
measures.yesMeans: Eureka's hotel tax rises from 10% to 12%.
